subject_rotation.angle_convention: 0 degrees is subject front facing the fixed camera; right and left describe which side of the subject becomes visible, not screen direction. Degrees are presets, not physical rotation guarantees.
subject_rotation.instruction: Rotate only the subject to the specified orientation, keeping the camera fixed and the background unchanged. Maintain realistic anatomy, grounding, occlusion, cast shadows and lighting consistency.
subject_rotation.notes: If a full-body turn changes the silhouette, update occlusions and contact shadows without moving or replacing the environment.
